name: Financial Assistance After Death (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: - ₹2,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the natural death. - ₹4,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the accidental death.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a dependent of the deceased construction worker. 1. The dependent’s name must be mentioned in the labour card as a dependent. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
